rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pilgrimage markers parallel spiritual stations such as patience, gratitude, trust, and contentment; a wayfarer must not violate their discipline or leave their proper state.
rows.anchor: من المقامات والأحوال التي يعلم بها حال السالك في سلوكه كالصبر والشكر والتوكل والرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as marked pilgrimage places and prescribed rites signal what the pilgrim should do, spiritual stations signal the wayfarer's condition and must retain their proper order.
rows.anchor: كما أن المواضع المعلومة المعلمة بما يفعل فيها كالمطاف والمسعى والمنحر وغيرها والأفعال المعلومة في الحج شعائر يشعر بها الحاج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author recounts an unnamed Sufi who endured a scorpion sting while discussing patience, ashamed to speak of a station while acting against it.
rows.anchor: أستحي من أن أتكلم في مقام وأنا أفعل ما ينافيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forbidden month signifies the true ihram of pilgrimage: the time of spiritual wayfaring and arrival, from which one must not depart or turn to distracting work.
rows.anchor: وقت الإحرام بالحج الحقيقي وهو وقت السلوك والوصول بالخروج عن حكمه والاشتغال بما ينافيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sacrificial offering represents the soul prepared for sacrifice upon reaching annihilation in the divine presence; do not divert, weaken, or overburden it with spiritual discipline beyond its capacity.
rows.anchor: النفس المستعدة المعدة للقربان عند الوصول إلى فناء الحضرة الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Garlands signify the wayfarer's outward marks, practices, and works; do not abandon or alter them from their proper form.
rows.anchor: ما قلدته النفس من شعار أهل السلوك والسنن والأعمال الظاهرة بتركها وتغييرها عن وضعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those journeying to the Sacred House are earnest spiritual wayfarers; do not obstruct their discipline, weaken their resolve through company, reduce their effort, or distract them.
rows.anchor: القاصدين المجدين في السلوك المجتهدين بتغيرهم ومنعهم عن الرياضة وإيهان عزائمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They seek divine favor through manifestations of acts and divine approval through manifestations of attributes.
rows.anchor: يبتغون فضلا من ربهم } بتجليات الأفعال { ورضوانا } بتجليات الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to subsistence after annihilation and attaining steadiness permits beneficial pleasures; enjoying them may assist witnessing and unveiling because of the soul's refinement.
rows.anchor: بالرجوع إلى البقاء بعد الفناء والاستقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not completely suppress resistant psychic faculties or deny them their sustaining rights because they obstruct the path; doing so harms the wayfarer in return.
rows.anchor: أن تقهروها بالكلية بمنعها عن الحقوق التي تقوم بها فتبطلوها أو تضعفوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the warning concerns hostility toward family, relatives, and friends because they dissuade one from detachment and spiritual discipline.
rows.anchor: أو عداوة قوم من أهليكم وأقاربكم وأصدقائكم بسبب منعهم إياكم عن التجريد والرياضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not retaliate against such people by harming them, hating them, or wishing them evil, since that damages spiritual progress more than their obstruction does.
rows.anchor: عليهم بإضرارهم ومقتهم وإرادة الشر بهم فإنه أضر بكم في السلوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cooperation in righteousness means governing faculties kindly, giving them their due while restraining their indulgences.
rows.anchor: بتدبير تلك القوى وسياستها بالإحسان إليها بحقوقها ومنعها من حظوظها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It can also mean supporting family and friends with kindness and customary good treatment despite their disagreement with one's spiritual course.
rows.anchor: بمواساتهم والإحسان إليهم، والمعروف في حقهم مع مخالفتهم إلى ما يمنعكم عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Make God a protection in these matters and fear Him in their violation; He punishes by obstruction and deprivation.
rows.anchor: واجعلوه وقاية لكم في هذه الأمور واحذروه في خلافها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The permitted good things are divine realities, true knowledge, and intellectual virtues acquired through intellect, heart, and spirit.
rows.anchor: من الحقائق والمعارف الحقية والفضائل العلمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Trained hunting animals symbolize outward and inward senses, other faculties, and bodily instruments used to acquire virtues and good manners.
rows.anchor: من جوارح حواسكم الظاهرة والباطنة وسائر قواكم وآلاتكم البدنية في اكتساب الفضائل والآداب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Training them with what God taught means using moral and legal sciences that explain how to enjoy pleasures fairly.
rows.anchor: من علوم الأخلاق والشرائع التي تبين طريق الاحتظاء من الحظوظ على وجه العدالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Use what the faculties acquire through proper teaching, inward intention, and a sound aim that perfects the person or community, rather than pursuing their own pleasure and appetite.
rows.anchor: على ما ينبغي بنية وإرادة قلبية وغرض صحيح يؤدي إلى كمال الشخص أو النوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God's name means inwardly recognizing that these faculties serve the complete human form, not another goal; make God a safeguard so their use is good.
rows.anchor: واحضروا بقلوبكم أنها للصورة الإنسانية الكاملة تقصد وتراد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's swift accounting is the immediate imprint of acquired dispositions in the soul when one acts, rather than an accounting stretched across periods.
rows.anchor: يحاسبكم بها في آن لا في أزمنة، كحصول هيآتها في أنفسكم عند ارتكابها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hunting in true ihram means indulging psychic pleasures; the penalty concerns deliberate action driven by desire, rather than an accident or courtesy to a guest or companion.
rows.anchor: لا ترتكبوا الحظوظ النفسانية في حالة الإحرام الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The compensation is to subdue the animal-soul faculty involved in the indulgence with a measure corresponding to that pleasure.
rows.anchor: جزاء قهره تلك القوة التي ارتكب بها الحظ النفساني من قوى النفس البهيمية بأمر يوازي ذلك الحظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two just judges are the theoretical and practical intellects; they may be oneself, one's shaykhs, or senior companions who determine the penalty's form and amount.
rows.anchor: من العاقلتين النظرية والعملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sacrifice reaching the true Kaaba is the animal faculty's annihilation in God, possible for a strong, capable adept.
rows.anchor: الحقيقية، أي: في حال كون تلك القوة البهيمية هديا بإفنائها في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atonement may veil the inclination through charity or fasting, removing its imprint from the person.
rows.anchor: ستر بصدقة أو صيام يزيل ذلك الميل ويستر تلك الهيئة عن نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, give the faculty its due and stop there without indulging it, since it is needy.
rows.anchor: أو بإيتاء حق تلك القوة والاقتصار عليه دون الحظ فإنها مسكينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further atonement is to refrain from the faculty's acts in proportion to the pleasure until its desire subsides.
rows.anchor: أو إمساك عن أفعال تلك القوة بقدر ذلك الحظ كيما يزول عنها الميل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeating the offense brings divine vengeance through veiling and deprivation.
rows.anchor: بالحجب والحرمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's might bars access to the gardens of His might while the soul's attributes remain impure; His vengeance veils with darkness, manifested attributes, and residual existence.
rows.anchor: لا يمكن الوصول إلى جنات عزه مع كدورات صفات النفس

rows.speaker: الله
rows.claim: A divine saying tells Muhammad to warn the truthful devotees that God is jealous.
rows.anchor: قال تعالى لنبيه محمد عليه الصلاة والسلام: " أنذر الصديقين بأني غيور "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sea's game signifies knowledge, intelligibles, and intellectual benefits from the spiritual realm, available during the consecration of the divine presence.
rows.anchor: بحر العالم الروحاني من المعارف والمعقولات والحظوظ العلمية في إحرام الحضرة الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sea's food is beneficial knowledge that one is obligated to learn in dealings and ethics.
rows.anchor: من العلم النافع الذي هو حق واجب تعلمه في المعاملات والخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The recipients are both wayfarers on the path to God and travelers on the afterlife journey who secure lasting bliss.
rows.anchor: المسافرين لسفر الآخرة، المحرزين لأرباح النعيم الباقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The land's game represents the corporeal world of sensible things and psychic pleasures, from which the consecrated wayfarer must refrain.
rows.anchor: بر العالم الجسماني من المحسوسات والحظوظ النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Take God as protection during the journey and make yourselves a shield against the evils that block the way.
rows.anchor: واجعلوا الله وقاية لكم في سيركم لتسيروا به واجعلوا نفوسكم وقاية الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Know that you are gathered to God through annihilation in the Essence; strive on the path instead of stopping at veiled obstacles.
rows.anchor: بالفناء في الذات، فاجتهدوا في السلوك ولا تقفوا مع الموانع وراء الحجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping anything besides God means worshipping what has no real power or existence to benefit or harm.
rows.anchor: أنعبد ما لا قدرة ولا وجود له حقيقة فينفع أو يضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning back after guidance is returning to association after true guidance to divine unity.
rows.anchor: الهداية الحقيقية إلى التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lost wanderer is led by devils of imagination and fantasy through the wasteland of the soul, confused without path or goal; companions are thought and the practical and theoretical intellects.
rows.anchor: ذهبت به شياطين الوهم والتخيل في مهمة أرض النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wanderer does not heed companions calling to guidance because desire has blocked the heart's hearing.
rows.anchor: ولا يسمع لارتتاق سمع قلبه بالهوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's guidance alone is the path of unity.
rows.anchor: هداية الله التي هي طريق التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Submission to the Lord of the worlds means effacing one's attributes in the divine lordship, surrendering them to God, and making Him the one described by them.
rows.anchor: لننقاد لصفة الربوبية بمحو صفاتنا في المتجلى بها وإسلامها إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This inward prayer of presence makes God a safeguard in one's attributes, frees one from independent existence, and brings one to Him through annihilation.
rows.anchor: ونقسم صلاة الحضور القلبي ونتقيه ونجعله وقاية لنا في الصفات ليكون هو الموصوف به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night is the darkness of bodily nature during childhood and early youth.
rows.anchor: أظلم عليه ليل عالم الطبيعة الجسمانية في صباه وأول شبابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The star signifies the angelic realm of the human structure, namely the soul as spiritual spirit; Abraham experiences its life and lordship as God manifests through the name al-Muḥyī.
rows.anchor: كوكب ملكوت الهيكل الإنساني التي هي النفس المسماة روحا روحانية وجد فيضه وحياته وربوبيته منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The star's setting is the soul's passing from its station as the heart's light rises; recognizing the soul's contingency and bodily dependence, Abraham rejects what is veiled by the body and needy of another.
rows.anchor: بعبوره عن مقام النفس وطلوع نور القلب وإشراقه عليه بآثار الرشد والتعقل ومعرفته لإمكان النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rising moon is the heart reaching its station above the soul and receiving disclosures of realities; God manifests its illumination through the names al-ʿAlīm and al-Ḥakīm.
rows.anchor: قمر القلب بازغا بوصوله إلى مقام القلب وطلوعه من أفق النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the moon sets, the heart recognizes its light is received from the spirit and may disappear in the darkness of the soul and its attributes, so it turns toward the spirit's manifestation.
rows.anchor: نوره مستفاد من شمس الروح وإنه قد يتغيب في ظلمة النفس وصفاتها فيحتجب بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks for guidance to the divine light lest he join those, like Christians, who stop at luminous inner veils.
rows.anchor: الذين يحتجبون بالبواطن عنه كالنصارى الواقفين مع الحجب النورانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun signifies the spirit; its rising is the spirit's manifestation and illumination, with God showing its effusion and lordship through the names al-Shahīd and al-ʿAlī al-ʿAẓīm.
rows.anchor: فلما رأى الشمس } الروح { بازغة } بتجليها عليه وظهور نورها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the sun greater recognizes the spirit's greater majesty and intensity of light.
rows.anchor: هذا أكبر } لعظمته وشدة نورانيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun's setting signifies the overwhelming disclosures of the Real, the enduring Face's radiance, and the unveiling of the Essence at unity; then regarding spirit or existence as independent is association.
rows.anchor: وانكشاف حجاب الذات بوصوله إلى مقام الوحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At unity Abraham disavows every association because nothing has existence beside God.
rows.anchor: أي شيء كان إذ لا وجود لغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning his face means surrendering his essence and existence to the one who created the heavens of spirits and earth of the soul, turning from everything else through annihilation.
rows.anchor: أوجد سموات الأرواح وأرض النفس مائلا عن كل ما سواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction to eat what bears God's name, already explained in al-Māʾidah, grounds the warning against obeying and following those who mislead.
rows.anchor: معلوم مما مر في (المائدة) ومسبب للنهي عن طاعة المضلين واتباعهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Manifest sin consists of bad deeds and words performed by the limbs; hidden sin consists of corrupt beliefs and false resolutions.
rows.anchor: ظاهر الإثم } سيئات الأعمال والأقوال الظاهرة على الجوارح { وباطنه } العقائد الفاسدة والعزائم الباطلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who was dead represents the soul in ignorance and veiled by its own attributes; bringing it to life means knowledge and love of the Real, or unveiling the veils of its attributes through divine disclosures.
rows.anchor: بالجهل، وهو النفس وباحتجابه بصفاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The granted light may be God's guidance and knowledge, light from divine attributes, or light from God's sustaining presence in the Essence, according to the recipient's rank.
rows.anchor: من هدايتنا وعلمنا أو نورا من صفاتنا أو نورا منا بقيوميتنا له بذاتنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The example describes someone trapped in the darkness of the self, its attributes, and its acts, unable to emerge from them.
rows.anchor: في ظلمات من نفسه وصفاتها وأفعالها ليس بخارج منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The veiled are made to see their own deeds as good and remain screened by them.
rows.anchor: كذلك زين } للمحجوبين عملهم فاحتجبوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is the path of essential divine unity; the upright religion is eternally fixed, changed by no sect and abrogated by no scripture or law.
rows.anchor: دينا قيما } ثابتا أبدا لا تغيره الملل والنحل ولا تنسخه الشرائع والكتب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's way is turning from everything besides God, rising beyond all stations, and rejecting any false path involving association, even through one divine attribute.
rows.anchor: التي أعرض بها عن كل ما سواه بالترقي عن جميع المراتب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer means inward presence and spiritual witnessing; ritual sacrifice means drawing near through the heart or by whatever one approaches through the heart.
rows.anchor: قل إن صلاتي } أي: حضوري بالقلب وشهودي بالروح { ونسكي } أي: تقربي أو كل ما أتقرب به بالقلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Living through the Real and dying through the soul belong wholly to God: annihilation leaves neither the self nor anyone else a share.
rows.anchor: لا نصيب لي ولا لأحد غيري فيها لأني قمت به له بالفناء فلا وجود لي ولا لغيري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord of the worlds is Lord in the gathering that appears through the detailed forms of lordship; He has no partner in either unity or detail.
rows.anchor: رب العالمين } أي: له باعتبار الجمع في صورة تفاصيل الربوبية { لا شريك له } في ذلك جمعا وتفصيلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command means seeing no other in either unity or detailed forms and acting for God, as Q 53:17 describes the Prophet's unwavering sight.
rows.anchor: أمرت أن لا أرى غيره في عين الجمع ولا في صورة التفاصيل حتى أعمل له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being the first Muslim means surrendering to annihilation in the detailed rank of the Essence; outside that rank there is no first or last, Muslim or unbeliever.
rows.anchor: باعتبار الرتبة في تفاصيل الذات وإلا فلا أول ولا آخر ولا مسلم ولا كافر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The imaginative faculty is formed from the finest parts of the animal spirit, which arises in the heart from vaporous humors and ascends to the brain; that spirit is the body's hottest element, hence its association with fire.
rows.anchor: خلقت القوة الوهمية من ألطف أجزاء الروح الحيوانية التي تحدث في القلب من بخارية الأخلاط ولطافتها وترتقي إلى الدماغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heat prompts ascent and self-elevation; each angelic faculty grasps the qualities and perfections below it but not those above it, including bodily and animal-spirit capacities.
rows.anchor: كل قوة ملكوتية تطلع على خواص ما تحتها دون ما فوقها وعلى الكمالات البدنية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faculty's blindness to human spiritual and cardiac perfections causes its denial and refusal, while presuming to judge intelligibles and abstractions beyond its proper rank.
rows.anchor: واحتجابها عن الكمالات الإنسانية الروحانية والقلبية هو صورة إنكارها وعلة إبائها واستكبارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arrogance is pretending to possess a virtue one lacks; it does not befit the spiritual presence claimed by a faculty that elevates itself over reason.
rows.anchor: التظاهر بما ليس فيه من الفضيلة من صفات النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faculty's refusal to accept reason's judgment and overreach into abstract matters is the inward form of refusing to prostrate.
rows.anchor: والامتناع عن قبول حكم العقل هو صورة إبائها عن السجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is expelled from the exalted spiritual company and counted among low psychic powers attached to the bodily realm and enduring humiliation.
rows.anchor: من القوى النفسانية الملازمة للجهة السفلية الدائمة الهوان بملازمة الأبدان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The resurrection can be the intermediate rising after voluntary death, when the heart lives and primordial nature escapes the veils of embodied existence, or the greater rising after unity's annihilation with gifted real existence and true life.
rows.anchor: من قبور الأبدان وأجداث صفات النفس بعد الموت الإرادي في القيامة الوسطى بحياة القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first resurrection's person is the one purified, while the second is purified by God; Iblis cannot mislead either.
rows.anchor: المبعوث الأول هو المخلص بكسر اللام، والثاني هو المخلص بالفتح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis's oath reflects his veiling from the divine Essence but not from attributes and acts; he swears by the acts he witnesses and magnifies, as in Q 38:82.
rows.anchor: فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis blocks the straight path by obstructing the way to essential unity and distracting people with things besides God.
rows.anchor: في طريق التوحيد الذاتي وأمنعنهم عن سلوكها بأن أشغلهم بما سواك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He approaches from four directions; approach from below means sensory rulings and partial worldly measures, which do not themselves mislead and can aid natural and mathematical sciences and reason.
rows.anchor: من جهة الأحكام الحسية والتدابير الجزئية من باب المصالح الدنيوية غير موجب للضلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Approach from above is impossible because that direction faces the spirit, bringing true inspirations, angelic promptings, and spiritual knowledge and realities.
rows.anchor: وإتيانه من فوق غير ممكن له إذ الجهة العلوية هي التي تلي الروح ويرد منها الإلهامات الحقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From ahead, Iblis makes one feel safe from God's plan by stressing forgiveness and mercy, so one fears less and delays obedience.
rows.anchor: من بين يديه فبأن يؤمنه من مكر الله ويغره بأن الله غفور رحيم فلا يخاف فيثبطه عن الطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From behind, he frightens one with poverty and the needs of one's children, encouraging hoarding for an imagined long future.
rows.anchor: من خلفه فبأن يخوفه من الفقر وضيعة الأولاد من خلفه فيحرضه على الجمع والادخار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From the right, he beautifies virtues and feeds vanity about one's excellence, knowledge, and worship, veiling one through self-regard.
rows.anchor: من جهة اليمين، فبأن يزين عليه فضائله ويعجبه بفضله وعلمه وطاعته ويحجبه عن الله برؤية تفضيله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From the left, he urges sins, shameful acts, appetites, and pleasures.
rows.anchor: وأما عن شماله فبأن يحمله على المعاصي والمقابح ويدعوه إلى الشهوات واللذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most are ungrateful because they fail to employ their faculties, limbs, and God's gifts in obedience and drawing near to Him.
rows.anchor: مستعملين لقواهم وجوارحهم وما أنعم الله به عليهم في طريق الطاعة والتقرب إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He invokes Q 13:39, that God erases and confirms what He wills, subject to God's will.
rows.anchor: يمحوا الله ما يشآء ويثبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward Throne is the First Intellect, collectively imprinted with the forms of things and the locus of prior decree; the author cites a report of a caller from within the Throne.
rows.anchor: باطنه هو العقل الأول المرتسم بصور الأشياء على وجه كلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's establishing Himself over the Throne inwardly means intending authority over the First Intellect by affecting creation and inscribing its forms without turning toward anything else.
rows.anchor: فالاستواء عليه قصد الاستعلاء عليه بالتأثير في إيجاد الأشياء بإثبات صورها عليه قصدا مستويا من غير أن يلوي إلى شيء غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good in this world is justice and steadiness through subsistence after annihilation; good in the next is vision and increase.
rows.anchor: حسنة } العدالة والاستقامة بالبقاء بعد الفناء { وفي الآخرة حسنة } المشاهدة والزيادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hudnā means returning to God from the sins of one's own existence.
rows.anchor: إنا هدنا } رجعنا { إليك } عن ذنوب وجودنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's punishment here is the special, painful longing that comes from Him and the ache of separation; it is a rare and exalted state granted to those under special care.
rows.anchor: عذاب الشوق المخصوص بي الحاصل من جهتي، وإن كان أليما لشدة ألم الفراق،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This longing-pain is itself mercy, beyond measure, because the delight of arrival is incomparable, as Q 32:17 promises.
rows.anchor: ففي هذا العذاب رحمة لا يبلغ كنهها ولا يقدر قدرها من رحمة لذة الوصول

rows.speaker: أحدهم
rows.claim: An unnamed poet says every pleasure he attained pales beside the delight of yearning experienced as torment.
rows.anchor:
كما قال أحدهم:
وكل لذيذ قد نلت منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This divine longing-pain is more precious than red sulfur; no person is wholly deprived of some share of mercy.
rows.anchor:
إن هذا العذاب أعز من الكبريت الأحمر.
وأما الرحمة فلا يخلو من حظ منها أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God writes complete, perfect mercy especially for those who avoid every veil and give deserving people from their wealth, character, knowledge, and spiritual states.
rows.anchor: الحجب كلها ويفيضون مما رزقوا من الأموال والأخلاق والعلوم والأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who follow the unlettered Prophet are the Muḥammadan followers who take on divine attributes.
rows.anchor: والذين هم } بجميع صفاتنا يتصفون وهم { الذين يتبعون الرسول النبي الأمي } في آخر الزمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their piety follows Q 8:17 and Q 53:3 and 53:17: the Prophet's action and speech are attributed to God, and his sight neither swerved nor transgressed.
rows.anchor: وما رميت إذ رميت ولكن الله رمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving zakat means embodying Q 93:10-11 by not rebuffing the asker and speaking of God's blessing.
rows.anchor: وأما السآئل فلا تنهر وأما بنعمة ربك فحدث

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says he was given comprehensive concise speech and sent to complete noble character.
rows.anchor:
قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" أوتيت جوامع الكلم، وبعثت لأتمم مكارم الأخلاق "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People like cattle lack heart-perception of truths and knowledge that bring them near God, and fail to take heed through sight or hearing.
rows.anchor: لفقدان إدراك الحقائق والمعارف التي تقربهم من الله بالقلوب وعدم الاعتبار بالأعين والإذكار بالأسماع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are more astray because satanic tendencies distance them through corrupt beliefs and many schemes.
rows.anchor: لوجود الشيطنة فيهم الموجبة للبعد بفساد العقائد وكثرة المكايد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each divine name is the Essence together with an attribute, and God governs each affair through one of His names.
rows.anchor: كل اسم هو الذات مع صفة، والله يدبر كل أمر باسم من أسمائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Invoke God by the name suited to one's need; inward appeal means attaining readiness to receive that name's effect, such as knowledge, healing, or wealth.
rows.anchor: إذا طلب العلم يدعوه باسمه العليم، والمريض إذا طلب الشفاء يدعوه باسمه الشافي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Verbal invocation works through the intended name: saying Lord can mean the Knowing, Healer, or Enricher according to the need addressed.
rows.anchor: وأما بلسان القال كما إذا قال الأول: يا رب، يريد به يا عليم، لاختصاص ربوبيته بذلك الاسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Invocation through action means taking on the divine attribute: surrendering one's knowledge to God's knowledge, healing others by His healing, or becoming free of need through Him.
rows.anchor: وأما بلسان الفعل كما يدعوه الطالب السالك باتصافه بتلك الصفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is the invocation commanded to monotheist believers, who should comply.
rows.anchor: وهذه هي الدعوة المأمور بها الموحدون من المؤمنين فليمتثلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who deviate in God's names seek His attributes from other than Him and ascribe them elsewhere, thereby associating partners.
rows.anchor: وذروا الذين يلحدون في أسمائه } يطلبون هذه الصفات من غيره ويضيفونها إليه فيشركون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is the appearance of the greater resurrection, essential unity with the advent of the Mahdī; only God knows its time, and its knowledge overwhelms the heavens and earth.
rows.anchor: وقت ظهور القيامة الكبرى، أي: الوحدة الذاتية بوجود المهدي ولا يعلم وقتها إلا الله

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet says that those who set a time for the Mahdī's emergence are liars.
rows.anchor:
كما قال النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام في وقت خروج المهدي:
" كذب الوقاتون "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even when the Hour occurs, only God knows it, and its weight is beyond the inhabitants of heaven and earth to comprehend.
rows.anchor: ما يعلمها عند وقوعها أيضا إلا الله كما هي قبل وقوعها. { ثقلت في السموات والأرض } إذ لا يسع أهلها علمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever reaches a person corresponds to that person's preparedness, sought through an unspoken prayer of state and deservedness.
rows.anchor: كل ما يصل إلى الإنسان هو الذي يقتضيه استعداده ويسأله بدعاء الحال وسؤال الاستحقاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A blessing remains while preparedness and goodness endure; it changes when veiling corrupts receptivity, potential good turns to evil, and darkness removes any capacity or affinity for good.
rows.anchor: لم يغيرها حتى أفسد استعداده وغير قبوله للصلاح بالاحتجاب وانقلاب الخير الذي فيه بالقوة إلى الشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Changing the blessing into punishment is just and responsive to the recipient's own preparedness and affinity, not oppression or injustice.
rows.anchor: فيغيرها إلى النقمة عدلا منه وجودا وطلبا من ذلك الاستعداد إياها بجاذبة الجنسية والمناسبة لا ظلما وجورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers' hearts unite through shared orientation and freedom from egoic traits; while governed by the lower soul, competing partial interests breed wrath, pride, estrangement, and conflict.
rows.anchor: لاتفاقها في الوجهة وخلاصها عن قيود صفات النفس التي تستلزم التخالف والتعاند

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning toward the higher realm and the unity of attributes or Essence lifts hearts from the soul toward the spirit; their aims become universal and compatible, generating love among those alike in purity.
rows.anchor: وكلما بعد عن الجهة السفلية بالتوجه إلى الجهة العلوية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The closer people are to unity, the stronger their mutual love; faith's strength determines their affinity, like lines running from a circle's circumference to its center.
rows.anchor: وكلما كان أقرب إلى الوحدة كانت قوة المحبة فيه أقوى لشدة قربه لمن تدين بدينه كالخطوط الآتية من محيط الدائرة إلى مركزها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger is from his people's own souls, creating kinship and affinity through which his heart's light transforms them and removes the darkness of innate nature and habit.
rows.anchor: ليكون بينكم وبينه جنسية نفسانية بها تقع الألفة بينكم وبينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hardship pains him because divine love and unity make believers like his own limbs; their suffering is like the pain of an injured body part.
rows.anchor: مشقتكم ولقاؤكم المكروه لرأفته اللازمة للمحبة الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His eagerness to protect believers is like a person's care for every bodily part, refusing the loss or ruin of even a small part, and is greater because his perception is more subtle.
rows.anchor: لشدة اهتمامه بحفظكم كما يشتد اهتمام أحدنا بكل واحد من أجزاء جسده وجوارحه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His compassion saves believers from punishment by warning them against sins and disobedience.
rows.anchor: ينجيهم من العقاب بالتحذير عن الذنوب والمعاصي برأفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His mercy gives believers knowledge, spiritual insight, and perfections that draw them near through teaching and encouragement.
rows.anchor: يفيض عليهم العلوم والمعارف والكمالات المقربة بالتعليم والترغيب عليها برحمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people turn away because they lack or lose spiritual readiness and expose themselves to eternal misery, tell them God suffices without their aid.
rows.anchor: وأعرضوا عن قبول الرأفة والرحمة لعدم الاستعداد أو زواله وتعرضوا للشقاوة الأبدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The analogy is a painful, decaying limb that must be cut off; God alone suffices because none other exists as an effective agent or helper.
rows.anchor: العضو المألوم المتعفن الذي يجب قطعه عقلا، أي: الله كافيني ليس في الوجود إلا هو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Trusting God means recognizing no one else as acting and possessing no independent power or strength.
rows.anchor: لا أرى لأحد فعلا ولا حول ولا قوة إلا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great Throne encompasses everything, and God's judgment and command reach all from it.
rows.anchor: المحيط بكل شيء يأتي منه حكمه وأمره إلى الكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's mockers resemble libertines and shameless people who ridicule those observing religious law.
rows.anchor: كما ترى من عادة الشطار وذوي الخلاعة المشتهرين بالإباحة يستهزئون بالمتشرعين والمتقيدين بقيودها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah answers that they mock in ignorance, but he will mock them when the disastrous outcome of disbelief and veiling appears.
rows.anchor: عند ظهور وخامة عاقبة كفركم واحتجابكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humiliating worldly punishment may be destruction, death, illness, injury, hardship, or poverty, leaving the sufferer distressed by loss.
rows.anchor: في الدنيا من هلاك وموت أو مرض وضر أو شدة وفقر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The abiding afterlife punishment is the fire of deprivation, dark forms of vice, and loss.
rows.anchor: دائم في الآخرة من استيلاء نيران الحرمان وهيئات الرذائل المظلمة والخسران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boiling oven can signify the body's humors and excess moisture overcoming its innate heat and animal spirit.
rows.anchor: تنور البدن باستيلاء الأخلاط الفاسدة والرطوبات الفضلية على الحرارة الغريزية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the oven represents the people’s spiritual destruction as natural desire overwhelms the heart and drowns it in the sea of bodily matter.
rows.anchor: أو أمرنا بإهلاككم المعنوي وفار التنور باستيلاء ماء هوى الطبيعة على القلب وإغراقه في بحر الهيولى الجسماني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two of each pair are the enduring species and class forms of every type, which remain when individual instances perish.
rows.anchor: من كل صنفين من نوع اثنين هما صورتاهما النوعية والصنفية الباقيتان عند فناء الأشخاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Carrying them in the Ark means Noah knows these forms persist along with human spirits.
rows.anchor: ومعنى حملهما فيها: علمه ببقائهما مع بقاء الأرواح الإنسية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's knowledge is part of the Ark that contains all, since it comprises knowledge and action; what he knows is carried, and his knowing it is his carrying it.
rows.anchor: فإن علمه جزء من سفينته الحاوية للكل لتركبها من العلم والعمل، فمعلوميتهما محموليتهما وعالميته بهما حامليته إياهما فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's family means those connected to him in religion and way of life.
rows.anchor: ومن يتصل بك في دينك وسيرتك من أقاربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those excluded are people whose prior decree of destruction was due to their disbelief from eternity.
rows.anchor: أي: الحكم بإهلاكه في الأزل لكفره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers to be carried are those from Noah's people who believed in God.
rows.anchor: ومن آمن } بالله من أمتك
